products.title: La misa explicada (The Mass Explained)
products.body_html: La Misa no es un conjunto de ritos sin sentido. Cada palabra, gesto, y acción del sacerdote o del pueblo tiene un rico significado, fruto del amor con que la Iglesia ha querido celebrarla en sus más de dos mil años de historia.

products.title: La Fe Cristiana Explicada (The Catholic Faith Explained)
products.body_html: Descripción La fe cristiana explicada: Introducción al catolicismo es la traducción al español de la versión en inglés de Introducción al Catolicismo, 2.ª edición. Este libro contiene la misma enseñanza católica que se encuentra en el popular libro del texto original con temas ampliados. Basado en el Catecismo de la Iglesia Católica este texto cubre los principios básicos de la fe y lo que significa ser católico. Contiene veinticinco capítulos e incluye los temas de: La santa Iglesia católica La santísima Trinidad El Misterio Pascual La santísima Virgen María Los Sacramentos y la Oración La moral cristiana y el llamado universal a la santidad Y un nuevo capítulo sobre Doctrina Social Este libro ofrece una descripción general completa de las enseñanzas de la Iglesia Católica. Examinando el Credo, la Iglesia, lo Sacramentos, los Diez Mandamientos y las vidas de los santos. Esta versión en español presenta las enseñanzas y prácticas de la Iglesia de una manera sencilla. Introduction to Catholicism covers the essentials of the Catholic faith, based on Sacred Scripture and the Catechism of the Catholic Church. With particular focus on the nature of God and Revelation, The Decalogue, the

products.title: Nothing Wasted: A Five-Book Collection on Suffering and Hope
products.body_html: Save 25% on the complete collection. Five books, $58.99. You didn't sign up for this. The diagnosis, the loss, the season that won't lift. Eventually you find yourself asking a question that isn't philosophical, it's personal. What is this for? The Christian answer is a strange one. It isn't "everything happens for a reason," and it isn't "there's no reason at all." It's that our suffering, joined to Christ's suffering, actually does something. The pain isn't erased, and it isn't explained away, but neither is it wasted. These five books come at that claim from five different angles: philosophy, the counsel of a saint, the research of a psychologist, the basic architecture of the faith, and the daily practice of trusting God. Read together, they make a small library for anyone in the middle of something hard, or for anyone trying to help someone who is. What's inside Trusting God in the Present by Fr. Jacques Philippe ($9.99) 56 pages from one of the great living spiritual directors, on the only day you can actually trust God in: this one. Peace of heart in turbulent times, in a voice that never rushes you. Crucibles (PREORDER - Ships September 8, 2026.) by Ben Baran, Ph.D. ($19.95

products.title: Tarde te amé (Vida e influjo de San Agustín de Hipona) (Late Have I Loved You; the life and impact of St. Agustin of Hipona)
products.body_html: La vida de san Agustín de Hipona muestra una actitud nítida: la de perseguir la verdad e, inseparablemente, la de ansiar el amor. Si él se hubiera detenido en cualquiera de las vías racionales por las que incursionó, si hubiera silenciado los efluvios de su corazón, no sería el gran maestro del pensamiento cristiano y el gran guía para los sedientos de felicidad. The life of Saint Augustine of Hippo reveals a clear stance: that of pursuing truth and—inseparably—yearning for love. Had he stopped at any of the rational paths he explored, or silenced the stirrings of his heart, he would not be the great teacher of Christian thought and the great guide for those thirsting for happiness.

products.title: Bernardette o la Sonrisa de la Virgen (Bernadette or the Smile of the Virgin)
products.body_html: Esta biografía de santa Bernadette Soubirous, vidente de Lourdes, relata los acontecimientos con base en fuentes históricas. En esto se diferencía de la mayoría de los relatos biográficos sobre la vidente de Lourdes, que ofrecen versiones noveladas. This biography of Saint Bernadette Soubirous, the visionary of Lourdes, recounts the events based on historical sources. In this respect, it differs from most biographical accounts of the visionary of Lourdes, which offer fictionalized versions.

products.title: Edith Stein o la Búsqueda de Sentido (Edith Stein or the Search for Meaning)
products.body_html: Esta es una historia de búsqueda de sentido. Desde sus raíces judías, transitando por los áridos parajes de la filosofía hasta su conversión, su vida mística y su holocausto, el itinerario de Edith está marcado por el ansia de colmar un vacío: el de la Verdad e, inseparablemente, el del Amor. La Verdad y el Amor del Crucificado al que se une para siempre en una cámara de gas, portando su hábito carmelita orlado con la estrella de David. This is a story of a search for meaning. From her Jewish roots, traversing the arid landscapes of philosophy to her conversion, her mystical life, and her Holocaust, Edith’s journey is marked by a yearning to fill a void: that of Truth and, inseparably, that of Love. The Truth and Love of the Crucified One to whom she is united forever in a gas chamber, wearing her Carmelite habit marked with the Star of David.

products.title: Santificar el trabajo; El ideal de la excelencia cristiana (Sanctifying Work; The ideal of Christian Excellence)
products.body_html: Este libro ofrece un programa práctico de vida cristiana para el trabajo y la vida familiar. Siguiendo las enseñanzas de san Josemaría, muestra cómo santificar el trabajo, crecer moralmente y contribuir al bien de los demás. Partiendo de una espiritualidad laical, el texto desarrolla los tres aspectos propuestos por san Josemaría: santificar el trabajo, santificarse con el trabajo y santificar a los demás con el trabajo. This book offers a practical program for Christian living in the spheres of work and family life. Drawing upon the teachings of Saint Josemaría, it demonstrates how to sanctify one's work, grow morally, and contribute to the well-being of others. Grounded in a lay spirituality, the text elaborates upon the three aspects proposed by Saint Josemaría: sanctifying work, sanctifying oneself through work, and sanctifying others through work.

products.title: Moral Fundamental (Fundamental Ethics)
products.body_html: Este pequeño libro expone, principalmente, la doctrina bíblica y del magisterio más reciente acerca del actuar ético del creyente. Ante la crisis de la Moral en los últimos años, muchos reclaman una vuelta a los valores éticos y una explicación del fin último del ser humano, de la libertad, la conciencia y la ley moral, y también del sentido del pecado y la virtud: qué es actuar bien, y por qué nos conviene hacerlo. Este libro ofrece una breve síntesis de su fundamentación racional. This short book outlines, above all, the biblical doctrine and the teachings of the recent Magisterium regarding the ethical conduct of the believer. In the face of the moral crisis of recent years, many are calling for a return to ethical values and an explanation of the ultimate purpose of human existence—as well as of freedom, conscience, the moral law, and the meaning of sin and virtue: what it means to act rightly and why it is in our best interest to do so. This book offers a brief synthesis of the rational basis for these concepts.

products.title: The Way (Critical-Historical Edition)
products.body_html: Now available after a seven year translation effort, The Way: Critical-Historical Edition arrives in a hardback English-language edition that totals 1173 pages. This work brings out the interesting and little-known background to The Way’s 999 points, including the specific events in the life of its author, St. Josemaría Escrivá. It also explains the historical and cultural influences on the work. The book shows the text in translated English followed by an explanatory note on each point, as well as the original Spanish text and footnotes linking it to other points. This edition also includes chapters on the origins, editing, and publishing history of The Way and its predecessor, Spiritual Considerations , and editorial notes on the different editions of The Way .

products.title: Nuevo Testamento. La Biblia de la Iglesia en América. (En Español Latinoamericano) (The New Testament. The Bible of the Church in America. In Latinamerican Spanish)
products.body_html: El Nuevo Testamento de La Biblia de la Iglesia en América presenta una traducción clara y cercana al español latinoamericano, realizada a partir de los textos bíblicos originales en hebreo, arameo y griego. Su objetivo es invitar al lector a un encuentro personal y transformador con Jesucristo, con un lenguaje fiel a la Sagrada Escritura y plenamente accesible para el fieles de hoy. Concebida mediante un amplio trabajo colaborativo dentro de la Iglesia, esta edición habla con claridad pastoral y calidez humana. Incluye una ilustración e introducción para cada libro, junto con citas de referencias, notas y elegantes hojas finales impresas, las cuáles se convierten en herramientas que enriquecen la lectura, la meditación y la respuesta personal a la Palabra de Dios. Este hermoso y duradero Nuevo Testamento lleva el rostro de Cristo estampado en oro, reflejando la dignidad de las Sagradas Escrituras. Cuenta con las siguientes características: La tapa dura tiene un acabado suave. La encuadernación cosida tipo Smyth permite que el libro permanezca abierto con facilidad y resista el uso diario. Las guardas artísticas impresas en oro están reforzadas, combinando durabilidad y belleza. La

products.title: Historia de la Iglesia (History of the Church)
products.body_html: La historia del cristianismo interesa al lector católico, pues es su historia de familia; pero debe interesar también a cualquier persona culta, porque constituye una parte esencial de la historia de la humanidad en los dos últimos milenios. El autor encuadra esa historia en el contexto histórico general, teniendo presente el momento social, cultural y político en que vivieron los cristianos en cada época, hasta nuestros dias. The history of Christianity is of interest to the Catholic reader, for it is their family history; yet it should also interest any educated person, as it constitutes an essential part of the history of humanity over the last two millennia. The author situates this history within its broader historical context, keeping in mind the social, cultural, and political environment in which Christians lived during each era, right up to the present day.

products.title: Pedro Ballester. Un apóstol del siglo XXI (Pedro Ballester, an Apostle of the XXI Century)
products.body_html: Pedro Ballester Arenas, Pedrito para los más cercanos, era un joven enamorado de la vida. Pedro murio de Cancer muy joven. Buen estudiante y gran amigo, hijo y hermano; aunque, como todos, también tenía sus luchas y defectos. La enfermedad fue para él una verdadera forja en la que se puso de manifiesto su fidelidad a la propia vocación. El modo en que la afrontó, aunque no faltaron derrotas en medio del combate, se ha convertido en fuente de inspiración para muchas personas. En su alegría en medio del dolor, este joven nos recuerda que todos estamos llamados a la santidad en cualquier circunstancia de nuestra vida. Pedro Ballester Arenas—Pedrito to those closest to him—was a young man in love with life. He died of Cancer at a young age. He was a good student and a wonderful friend, son, and brother; though, like everyone else, he too had his struggles and flaws. For him, his illness served as a true crucible in which his fidelity to his own vocation was revealed. The manner in which he faced it—even though there were defeats amidst the struggle—has become a source of inspiration for many people. Through his joy in the midst of suffering, this young man reminds us that we are all ca

products.title: IA: Desafíos y oportunidades (AI: Challenges and Opportunities)
products.body_html: Este libro acerca los conceptos clave de la inteligencia artificial con un lenguaje claro y accesible a cualquier lector, a la vez que invita a reflexionar sobre los desafíos, presentes y futuros, que la creación y el uso de la IA esta planteando en nuestra vida cotidiana. La obra se adentra en el pasado, presente y futuro de la IA en tres capítulos que constituyen tres miradas complementarias que desmontan mitos, revelan verdades poco conocidas y muestran hacia dónde podría llevarnos esta tecnología en los próximos años. Más que ofrecer respuestas cerradas, este libro abre puertas. Plantea preguntas, despierta curiosidad y deja en las manos del lector la oportunidad de construir su propio criterio en un mundo donde la inteligencia artificial ya es, y será cada vez más, protagonista. This book introduces the key concepts of artificial intelligence using clear, accessible language suitable for any reader, while simultaneously inviting reflection on the present and future challenges that the creation and use of AI pose to our daily lives. The work delves into the past, present, and future of AI across three chapters that offer three complementary perspectives—dismantling myths, revea

products.title: Caer y Levantarse; 12 Razones Para Seguir (Falling and getting back up; 12 reasons to keep going)
products.body_html: Si alguna vez, o muchas, te has desanimado o rendido en la vida, este libro te interesa. En él conocerás a muchos protagonistas, todos reales, cuyas historias te sorprenderán. Ellos te mostrarán la importancia de aprender a convivir con nuestra debilidad, cuidarnos, querernos más y proteger nuestro corazón. Las vivencias sacerdotales del Pater Pablo te presentan un futuro esperanzador en el que encontrarás la razón y la fuerza para seguir adelante. Te levantarás todas las veces necesarias y, todo ello, con la ayuda de Dios. If you have ever—or perhaps often—felt discouraged or given up in life, this book is for you. Inside, you will meet many protagonists—all real people—whose stories will surprise you. They will show you the importance of learning to live with our weaknesses, taking care of ourselves, loving ourselves more, and protecting our hearts. Father Pablo’s experiences as a priest present a hopeful future in which you will find the reason and the strength to keep moving forward. You will rise again as many times as necessary—and you will do it all with the help of God.

products.title: El matrimonio, un bien precioso. Razones para casarse en la Iglesia (Marriage, a Precious Good. Reasons to Get Married in the Church)
products.body_html: "El matrimonio es un bien precioso" -tal como lo definió Juan Pablo II- que llena y da sentido a la vida de los esposos. Por eso, "los cristianos no podemos renunciar a proponer el matrimonio con el fin de no contradecir la sensibilidad actual. Estaríamos privando al mundo de los valores que podemos y debemos aportar", ha escrito el Papa Francisco. En estas páginas encontrarás el porqué de las razones del matrimonio en la Iglesia. "Marriage is a precious good"—just as John Paul II defined it—that fulfills and gives meaning to the lives of spouses. For this reason, "we Christians cannot renounce proposing marriage simply to avoid contradicting contemporary sensibilities. We would be depriving the world of the values that we can and must contribute," Pope Francis has written. In these pages, you will discover the reasons behind the Church's understanding of marriage.

products.title: De 4 a 6 años Creciendo felices (From 4 to 6 years old; growing up happy)
products.body_html: Guía esencial para padres de niños de 4 a 6 años. Descubre estrategias prácticas para educar con coherencia, fomentar el apego seguro y transmitir valores familiares para que tus hijos crezcan felices. Ser padre o madre es un reto que requiere paciencia, entrega y fortaleza... pero también es una de las experiencias más plenas y transformadoras de la vida. Este libro es una invitación a educar con coherencia, a alinear lo que pensamos con lo que hacemos y a descubrir que, en el camino de ayudar a nuestros hijos a crecer felices, también crecemos nosotros como personas. Creciendo felices combina la riqueza de la experiencia personal con los avances de la investigación científica para ofrecer una visión integral de la educación: desde el desarrollo infantil y la importancia del apego, hasta estrategias prácticas para transmitir valores y armonizar la vida familiar. An Essential Guide for Parents of Children Ages 4 to 6. Discover practical strategies to parent with consistency, foster secure attachment, and instill family values so that your children can grow up happy. Being a parent is a challenge that requires patience, dedication, and strength—yet it is also one of life’s most fulf

products.title: De 1 a 3 años; Descubriendo mundo (From 1 to 3 years old; discovering a new world)
products.body_html: La guía esencial para padres de niños de 1 a 3 años. Aprende a fomentar la autonomía y la educación en valores con rigor pedagógico para construir un vínculo familiar sólido desde la primera infancia. Durante los primeros años, los niños tropiezan y se levantan bajo la mirada atenta y amorosa de sus padres, quienes los acompañan brindándoles apoyo y, al mismo tiempo, el espacio necesario para que puedan crecer a su propio ritmo. Esta obra aborda temas esenciales como la educación en valores, la comunicación en la familia y el fomento de la autonomía, siempre desde la individualidad de cada niño. Una lectura imprescindible para padres, educadores y profesionales que desean fortalecer el vínculo familiar y construir hogares felices sobre bases sólidas y valores duraderos. Este libro nace de la experiencia de una madre y formadora con una sólida trayectoria, que combina el rigor pedagógico con una mirada actual a los retos de la educación. Inspirada en los avances científicos sobre el desarrollo infantil y enriquecida por años de práctica profesional, la autora comparte orientaciones realistas para acompañar el crecimiento integral de los niños en sus primeros años, esa etapa maravill

products.title: Novios 100% ¿Cómo tirar la caña con acierto? (100% Commited)
products.body_html: Novios 100%: la guía de noviazgo de Pep Borrell para un matrimonio feliz. Aprende a discernir el amor y a construir una relación para siempre, abordando sin prejuicios temas como el sexo revolucionario, las rupturas y el miedo al compromiso. Te quiero plantear un noviazgo para aspirar a un matrimonio feliz. Un noviazgo para conocerse, para discernir, para aprender a amar. Diez cuestiones a tener en cuenta, temas de conversación que no se pueden omitir. «El noviazgo no es un matrimonio en miniatura». Es mucho más importante que eso. Hablamos de un sexo revolucionario, de lo más healthy: eco sex power sin plásticos ni hormonas. El sexo más seguro: «una con uno para siempre». Te hará pensar: «¿sentimiento o voluntad de amar?» «¿Decidimos con la cabeza o con el corazón?» «¿Me conviene o no me conviene?» «¿Amor hasta que dure o para siempre?» «¿Se puede?». «El amor no se prueba, el amor se entrega» Y con cabeza decidimos a quién, porque «una relación no se encuentra, una relación se construye». Rupturas, segundas oportunidades, noviazgos a distancia, conocerse por redes, cohabitar antes de casarse, el miedo al compromiso, la futura familia política. Un libro de lectura muy fácil, políti

products.title: 100% Chicos (Boys Should Be Boys)
products.body_html: Desde su experiencia como pediatra y madre, Meg Meeker aporta las claves fundamentales que todos los padres debieran conocer sobre la educación de sus hijos. Frente al ambiente actual que tiende a acabar con las diferencias, la autora nos recuerda que los niños siempre serán niños y que, por lo tanto, precisan de una educación esencialmente diferente. Para ello, la doctora Meeker se adentra en temas fundamentales de la educación de los niños, entre los que se encuentran: Por qué las normas y los límites son fundamentales y por qué los chicos se sienten perdidos sin ellos. Por qué es muchísimo más provechoso para un chico jugar al aire libre que dedicarle horas a los videojuegos. Cómo preservar su inocencia frente a un ambiente que pretende todo lo contrario. Por qué no es normal que un niño sea taciturno o rebelde y como tratar esos comportamientos. Cómo y cuándo tratar las grandes cuestiones de la vida que todo niño se plantea. Todos los padres quieren lo mejor para sus hijos. Sin embargo, esto no parece ser suficiente. Educar es una impresionante tarea para la que hay que estar preparados. Sin duda alguna, este libro proporciona una serie de consejos que vienen a hacerla un poco

products.title: El cántico del cordero La música sacra y la liturgia divina (THE SONG OF THE LAMB - Sacred Music and the Heavenly Liturgy)
products.body_html: La liturgia es un don de Dios al hombre que involucra todos los sentidos. La Iglesia nos invita a participar de las celebraciones religiosas para recordarnos que la Palabra habita entre nosotros. Así, la música sacra, creada para acompañarnos en estos contextos, debería sumergirnos en la atmósfera celestial. Sin embargo, ¿con qué frecuencia el sonido de la liturgia nos deja con una sensación de vacío, distracción o nos parece un simple concierto? En este libro, el cardenal Robert Sarah se une a Peter Carter, director del Proyecto de Música Sacra Católica, para adentrarse en la rica tradición espiritual de la música sacra católica, desde los inicios de la Iglesia hasta el Concilio Vaticano II y más acá. El cardenal critica la confusión litúrgica de nuestros tiempos, que ha afectado a todos los rincones de la Iglesia. Además, trata de que los lectores se enamoren más profundamente de la Misa y aviva la llama de la renovación litúrgica que los cristianos de todo el mundo tanto anhelan. Sacred music, then, should immerse us — however imperfectly — in the atmosphere of heaven. Yet how often does the sound of the liturgy leave us feeling empty, or distracted? How often does music at Mass

products.title: Orar en el Duelo (Praying in Times of Grief)
products.body_html: Orar en el duelo ha venido a cubrir un vacío, por su contenido y por su originalidad. Es más que un libro de oraciones. Es también poema y testimonio, pensamientos y sorbos de sabiduría...? Un libro que recoge y da voz al eco común que brota del fondo del corazón de quienes están viviendo la amarga estación del duelo. Es un libro que ha nacido de la experiencia y de la sabiduría del corazón creyente de sus autores, de la escucha y del acompañamiento. Ayudará a muchos en la difícil travesía por el desierto del duelo hacia el éxodo de la esperanza. "Praying in times of Grief" has come to fill a void, both for its content and its originality. It is more than a prayer book. It is also a poem and a testimony, thoughts and sips of wisdom... A book that gathers and gives voice to the common echo that springs from the depths of the hearts of those experiencing the bitter season of grief. It is a book born from the experience and wisdom of the believing hearts of its authors, from listening and accompanying others. It will help many on the difficult journey through the desert of grief toward the exodus of hope.

products.title: Oraciones para rezar en familia (Prayers to say as a family)
products.body_html: ¿Dónde, cómo se forjan nuestras creencias profundas , esas que dan sentido a nuestra vida ? En una gran medida, en el ámbito de la familia. El testimonio de nuestros padres nos inclina en un sentido o en otro, nos hace ver las cosas desde una perspectiva. La educación en la fe forma parte de la oración. La familia sigue teniendo que responder a la petición de los apóstoles: Señor, enséñanos a orar. Where and how are our deepest beliefs formed—those that give meaning to our lives? To a great extent, within the family. The example of our parents inclines us in one direction or another, shaping our perspective. Education in the faith is an integral part of prayer. Families still have to respond to the apostles' request: Lord, teach us to pray.

products.title: Orar con Teresa de Lisieux (Praying with Therese of Lisieux)
products.body_html: Teresa de Lisieux. Encerrada siempre entre cuatro paredes. Patrona de las misiones. Apenas cursa estudios. Doctora de la Iglesia. Sufre una larga y dolorosa enfermedad y no pierde la sonrisa. Padece unas pruebas enormes en su fe; rebosa de seguridad y paz. No siente nada pero habla con pasión de Jesús. Un personaje grande de la historia. Siempre trató de ser pequeña. Thérèse of Lisieux. Confined within four walls. Patroness of the missions. With little formal education. Doctor of the Church. She endured a long, painful illness yet never lost her smile. She suffered immense trials of faith, yet overflowed with confidence and peace. She felt nothing, yet spoke of Jesus with passion. A great figure in history. She always strove to be little.

products.title: Good, Better, Best! Fostering Good Work Habits in Children
products.body_html: Mothers and fathers are the original human resource managers! Whatever the era or circumstances, their challenges remain constant: to pass on a legacy of positive work attitudes and habits to their children. In Good, Better, Best author Esther Esteban focuses on five work-related habits: diligence, order, responsibility, cooperation, and cheerfulness. These are the building blocks of good work that take time and considerable training to develop. When they are practiced naturally, quickly, constantly, and with ease, they evolve into stable qualities of the human personality (virtues). Motivating children to do their work (school work, play, household chores, hobbies, sports), and to sustain and complete tasks well, are the challenges of parents, caregivers, and teachers. This sequel to The Work of Children is an inspirational guide to help them in that process.

products.title: Life in God's Presence (eBook only)
products.body_html: Every soul strives for unity with God. Over the centuries, spiritual guides have offered myriad methods for achieving such an intimate relationship. But those sincerely invested in the spiritual life know there is no shortcut to finding God. There is only one true path: through Christ. This slim volume, penned by an anonymous Carthusian monk in the early twentieth century, offers a direct and practical way to advance one’s personal holiness. Set upon a foundation of Christ’s own words in the Gospels, Life in God’s Presence confesses that God offers every soul the means to unity with Him through the virtues of faith, hope, and love. These virtues, coupled with a straightforward, childlike approach to prayer, can lead a soul to recognize God’s presence in every aspect of daily life. By constantly and genuinely offering Him “all of our time, all of our strength, our whole soul”, eternal life need not wait until after death; it can begin here and now.

products.title: Entrenado por el apostol Pablo: Lecciones en transformacion (Coached by Paul the Apostle: Lessons in Transformation)
products.body_html: También disponible en inglés! La transformación inicial de San Pablo fue un cambio drástico de Saulo a Pablo, de perseguidor a creyente, de la oscuridad a la luz. Sin embargo, la caída de las escamas de sus ojos fue solo el comienzo: vivió y enseñó las lecciones de dicha transformación durante el resto de su vida. En su libro, el P. Cromly revela la universalidad y perennidad del liderazgo de San Pablo, lo que puede suceder si permitimos que Cristo transforme nuestras vidas, y cómo en este gran santo que en realidad es muy parecido a nosotros, podemos encontrar un gran guía para nuestro camino. Pablo es quien nos desafía a ser cristianos influyentes en un mundo frecuentemente peligroso, y quien nos muestra cómo transformar nuestros miedos en valentía, nuestros rechazos en oportunidades, nuestro sufrimiento en gracia, y nuestra soledad en unión con Cristo.

products.body_html: Take the guesswork out of your summer reading by adding a little mystery to it. No endless browsing, no agonizing over what to pick. Just open the package, start reading, and let something unexpected find its way onto your shelf.

products.body_html: Take the guesswork out of your summer reading by adding a little mystery to it. products.title: PREORDER - St. Michael and His World
products.body_html: Available for preorder. Orders ship September 2026. The great wings of the Archangel Michael overshadow all human history. He is mentioned in three books of the Bible, but the Church Fathers and ancient rabbis saw him in many other places, unnamed, hidden in plain sight. In St. Michael and His World , Mike Aquilina explores the biblical record alongside its interpretations from antiquity, unveiling a history - from creation to the end - in which St. Michael is a constant and active presence. But this is not a book about mythology or pious legend. Drawing on Scripture, rabbinic texts, the Dead Sea Scrolls, patristic writings, Coptic tradition, and Islamic sources, Aquilina traces how the Church's greatest archangel has captured the imagination of believers across two millennia. From Daniel's visions to the vision that inspired Pope Leo XIII to revive his devotion in the modern age, St. Michael emerges not as a distant heavenly abstraction, but as a figure central to how Christians have understood spiritual warfare, divine providence, and the cosmic struggle between good and evil. For those seeking to understand the invisible warfare that shapes human history, or for those simply cur

products.title: Esperanza para los momentos díficiles (Hope in Difficult Times)
products.body_html: Scott Hahn, experto en Sagrada Escritura, te ofrece esperanza para los momentos difíciles. Descubre con la Biblia y los santos cómo el dolor y el sufrimiento no tienen por qué llevar a la infelicidad, sino a la plenitud espiritual. La incomprensión del dolor y el sufrimiento es una experiencia vital. Los santos y la Biblia nos enseñan que las dificultades no tienen por qué hacernos infelices. Esto es precisamente lo que pretende mostrar en estas páginas el autor del libro, Scott Hahn, experto en Sagrada Escritura. Scott Hahn, an expert in Sacred Scripture, offers you hope for difficult times. Discover—through the Bible and the saints—how pain and suffering need not lead to unhappiness, but rather to spiritual fulfillment. Grappling with the mystery of pain and suffering is a fundamental human experience. The saints and the Bible teach us that hardships need not make us unhappy. This is precisely what the book's author, Scott Hahn—an expert in Sacred Scripture—sets out to demonstrate within these pages.

products.title: PREORDER - Staying Sober One Story at a Time
products.body_html: Available for preorder. Orders ship October 2026. What do a struggling New York writer, a failed British diplomat, a disillusioned aristocrat, and a weary Catholic priest have in common? Each reveals, in his own way, the brutal cost of addiction—and possible paths toward recovery. Ascetic theology meets literary fiction in this exploration of alcoholism and sobriety through the lens of four twentieth-century novels. Through the manipulative self-destruction of Don Birnam ( The Lost Weekend ), the tragic descent of Geoffrey Firmin ( Under the Volcano ), the spiritual collapse of Sebastian Flyte ( Brideshead Revisited ), and the hopeful redemption of Fr. Hugh Kennedy ( The Edge of Sadness ), readers are invited to consider a deeply Catholic approach to addiction and healing: one rooted in spiritual and moral discipline, honest self-examination, and daily conversion. Both realistic and redemptive, Staying Sober One Story at a Time is a unique guide for anyone seeking sobriety, supporting someone who is, or longing for a deeper spiritual response to the wounds of addiction.

products.title: St. Josemaría Essentials Collection
products.body_html: Meet the saint Pope John Paul II described as a "master in the practice of prayer"... For decades, the writings of St. Josemaría Escrivá have guided millions of people toward a deeper, more integrated faith — one lived not in spite of ordinary life, but through it. This collection brings together eight of his most beloved works, spanning spiritual direction, prayer, and homilies, at a 15% savings from the regular list price. Includes: The Way Furrow The Forge Christ is Passing By Friends of God Holy Rosary Way of the Cross In Love with the Church

products.title: Crucibles: How Faith and Science Help Us Navigate Suffering
products.body_html: Life's trials can break us—or they can forge us. When tragedy struck his family, Ben Baran was forced to confront suffering in its rawest form. In the aftermath, Baran—Navy admiral, organizational psychologist, Catholic, husband, and father—sought answers to the questions all of us eventually face: How do we endure the unendurable? What purpose might suffering serve? Can faith and science together show us a way through? Crucibles is his honest and hope-filled response. Baran weaves insights from psychology and sociology with the Catholic tradition, especially teachings of St. John Paul II. He explores how adversity can both wound and transform. Drawing on stories from Antarctic explorers, Holocaust survivors, soldiers, saints, and parents, he shows how life's crucibles are unavoidable, but also potentially redemptive: clarifying who we are, forging resilience, and binding us together in solidarity. A guide for anyone facing hardship or preparing for it, this candid and compassionate book is full of raw beauty and honest hope, reminding us that, even in our deepest trials, we are never alone.

products.title: Trusting God in the Present
products.body_html: Life is always full of new and unexpected challenges, but each challenge is also an opportunity to draw closer to God. Fr. Jacques Philippe, a beloved author and renowned spiritual director, will show you how to maintain peace of heart through turbulent times and discern the choices that will be helpful for you and others. Written in a simple and inviting style, Trusting God in the Present is your spiritual direction manual to trusting God in the midst of difficult times. You’ll find that God is, indeed, with you, and he is inviting you to a new perspective, renewed hope, and a more abundant life.

products.title: Lessons for Sharing the Gospel
products.body_html: With simplicity and wisdom, Fr. Jacques Philippe shares how evangelization comes from a deep compassion for others.

products.title: In Conversation with God + Daily Roman Missal: Your Daily Spiritual Companions
products.body_html: Transform your prayer life with the ultimate Catholic spiritual bundle. This set pairs the complete 7-volume In Conversation with God series with the comprehensive Daily Roman Missal, 7th Edition , giving you everything needed to follow the Mass and deepen your prayer throughout the year. What's Included: In Conversation with God (7 volumes, 4,000 pages): Daily meditations following the Church's liturgical calendar by Francis Fernández-Carvajal, with themes drawn from the Mass readings. Volumes cover Advent and Christmas, Lent and Eastertide, Ordinary Time, and Special Feasts. Daily Roman Missal (2,558 pages): Complete texts for all daily and Sunday Masses, with English and Latin side-by-side for the Order of Mass. Includes readings for all three Sunday cycles and the two-year weekday cycle, plus over 200 pages of devotions and prayers. Available in hardcover or bonded leather, burgundy or black binding. Whether you're a new Catholic seeking to establish a strong prayer foundation or a lifelong believer, this bundle provides structured guidance for daily meditation and Mass participation throughout the entire liturgical year. Makes an exceptional gift for RCIA candidates, converts,

products.title: The Word of God Inspired for Our Salvation
products.body_html: The Bible is God's love letter, written to draw us into his life and his plan for our salvation. Theologian Jeffrey L. Morrow offers a clear, engaging, and faithful introduction to Sacred Scripture for Catholics hoping to understand the Bible more confidently and prayerfully. Drawing from the Church's teaching, the wisdom of the Fathers, and the best of contemporary scholarship, Morrow guides readers through: - What biblical inspiration really means—and why Scripture is wholly true, trustworthy, and divinely authored. - How to interpret the Bible "from the heart of the Church," through the literal and spiritual senses. - How archaeology and history powerfully support Scripture's remarkable reliability. - A tour of each major section of the Bible, illuminating its themes, contexts, and place within salvation history. - How every book of the Bible fits into the story of salvation. More than an overview, this book invites readers to encounter the living God in the pages of the Bible—to understand not only what Scripture says, but why it was written: ". . . that the man of God may be complete, equipped for every good work" (2 Tm 3:17). Whether you are opening the Bible for the first ti

products.title: Biblia de Jerusalen, letra grande. (Spanish Version - Jerusalem Bible. Large print.)
products.body_html: Los textos sagrados de ayer a la luz de la ciencia de hoy. No es sólo una BIBLIA; es la BIBLIA al alcance de todos. 5ta Edicion Encuadernación en tapa dura, geltex estampado a dos colores Tipografía mejorada Nuevo diseño más limpio y optimizado Más manejable y cómoda Texto actualizado a la 5ª edición Incluye 17 prácticos uñeros para la búsqueda de los libros bíblicos. The sacred texts of the past in the light of modern science. It is not just a Bible; it is *the* Bible, accessible to everyone. 5th Edition. Hardcover binding with two-color stamped Geltex finish. Improved typography. New, cleaner, and optimized design. Easier to handle and more comfortable to use. Text updated to the 5th edition. Includes 17 practical thumb tabs for locating books of the Bible.

products.title: Love Finds a Way: Building a Friendship with Christ in the Midst of Life
products.body_html: Are you a Catholic striving to live your faith more deeply, but sensing that God is asking more of you? In Love Finds a Way , Stephen Gabriel shares a deeply personal and practical guide for cultivating a richer interior life. Drawing on the wisdom of St. Josemaría and the spiritual tradition of the Church, Gabriel offers encouragement, structure, and specific devotions to help lay Catholics grow in friendship with Christ. From daily Mass and the Rosary to mental prayer, confession, and spiritual direction, this book presents a "plan of life" that integrates faith into every corner of daily living. With warmth, clarity, and humility, Love Finds a Way helps ordinary Catholics answer Jesus's extraordinary call to holiness, right in the midst of family life, work, and the world.

products.title: A Treasure for the Church: St. Josemaría on Marriage, Family, and Education
products.body_html: Pope Paul VI said in 1975 that the oral and written teachings of St. Josemaría were “a treasure not just for Opus Dei, but for the whole Church” and they should be written down and shared. A Treasure for the Church brings together St. Josemaría's personal, heartfelt answers to real-life questions posed during his catechetical gatherings in Spain (1972) and throughout Latin America (1974-1975). Drawn from his conversations with parents, educators, and youth, this book captures his timeless, practical advice for forming Christian character at home, in school, and in the world. While especially helpful for parents, educators, and catechists, this book, with its powerful insights, will also resonate with youth leaders, young adults, and anyone committed to developing character through faith and love. Accessible and inspiring, this unique volume is the first to publish in English St. Josemaría’s spoken responses from these three pastoral trips, offering a treasure of practical wisdom for all who wish to build strong families, schools, and communities rooted in Christ. To access the online bibliography, please visit www.scepterpublishers.org/madonnamurphy

products.title: Un Dios que Perdona (A God who Forgives)
Ascetica meditada(Version Jesus as Friend)
products.body_html: En esta obra, el autor nos ofrece meditaciones encaminadas al enriquecimiento de nuestra vida espiritual. Las personas en la actualidad nos enfrentamos a dos grandes enemigos: el pesimismo y el desaliento que obstruyen nuestro camino cotidiano. Estos dos grandes enemigos pueden combatirse desde la esperanza, la virtud que enseña al hombre a recomenzar ante cualquier fracaso e infunde serenidad y confianza en Dios. In this work, the author offers us meditations aimed at enriching our spiritual lives. Today, we face two great enemies—pessimism and discouragement—that obstruct our daily path. These two formidable foes can be combated through hope, the virtue that teaches us to start anew after any failure and instills serenity and trust in God.

products.title: The Fire and the Silence: Prayer, Thought, and the Battle for Inner Stillness
products.body_html: Why is it so hard to pray without distraction? Why does our mind wander to everything except God when we kneel to speak with him? And what do we do with the flood of thoughts that seem to overtake us in the very act of prayer? In this deeply contemplative yet practical book, Fr. John Henry Hanson takes us on a journey through the battleground of the mind, where attention, memory, and imagination often seem like saboteurs to prayer. Drawing on Scripture, the Desert Fathers, saints like Teresa of Avila and Augustine, and insights from modern psychology, this book offers not a quick fix, but something far better: a quiet revolution against wayward thoughts, a spiritual reorientation toward God. Fr. Hanson helps readers to understand how God meets us even in mental chaos: how he works not despite our distractions, but sometimes through them. Along the way, readers will discover the role of grace in thought-life, how to respond to distraction, and what it means to have ""the mind of Christ."" With lyrical clarity, theological depth, and a pastoral heart, this book becomes not merely a guide to prayer, but a companion in it. "

products.title: The Four First Things: Foundations for a Deeper Life with God
products.body_html: The path to deep faith isn't complicated: it's clear, powerful, and already within reach. In this world of endless noise, shifting values, and spiritual confusion, The Four First Things calls us back to the beginning—to the foundational truths that can shape our lives, heal our hearts, and lead us into a profound relationship with God. Joseph S. Reel presents four essential principles as the "first things" every soul must return to again and again. These are accessible anchors for anyone seeking to grow in their faith, whether just beginning the journey or longing to go deeper within it. This book: Shows why, without God, even our highest ideals fall apart Describes God’s invitation to create freely with him Explains how suffering and evil fit within a God-given world Gives practical tools for developing unwavering trust in God’s Will Reminds us that no detail is too small for God's love and help Written for young adults exploring their faith, spiritual seekers, lapsed believers, and the already devoted who need fresh inspiration, this powerful book is a short read with a lasting impact. Above all, it aims to awaken a burning desire to love God with our whole heart, soul, mind, and

products.title: Prince, Patron, and Patriarch: The Litany of St. Joseph and the Dogma That Makes It Strong
products.body_html: St. Joseph is often called the Silent Saint—but in this bold and beautifully structured meditation, his voice resounds loud and clear as a spiritual father, guardian, and intercessor for the whole Church. Ian Mahood leads readers through meditations on each title of the Litany of St. Joseph, grounding every reflection in Scripture and Church teaching. This is a doctrinally solid invitation to love the foster father of Jesus more deeply, a place where dogma and devotion meet. Ideal for daily reflection, catechesis, or as a personal Josephite consecration, this book reveals the man who was entrusted with the highest of responsibilities, and the implications and meaning in our own lives. Let St. Joseph guide you to love Christ more fully, follow him more faithfully, and trust God's plan more completely. Discover the man behind the titles. Meet the SAINT who raised the SAVIOR.

products.title: El Hogar Consciente (Spanish edition of The Thoughful Home)
products.body_html: También disponible en inglés! El hogar consciente de Dia Boyle es una reflexión profunda sobre el sentido del hogar como espacio vital donde las personas no solo habitan, sino que crecen, florecen y se sostienen mutuamente. La autora distingue entre una casa como estructura material y un hoga como lugar de cuidado, pertenencia y atención a las necesidades humanas. Frente a la ansiedad moderna y al consumismo, propone redescubrir la figura de la homemaker (ama del hogar), entendida como artífice y custodio de ese ambiente. El libro combina filosofía práctica, ejemplos culturales y experiencias cotidianas para iluminar lo que significa vivir en un hogar consciente. Su propósito es brindar claridad y confianza a quienes desean construir hogares donde las necesidades materiales, emocionales, intelectuales y espirituales sean atendidas. En suma, es una invitación a hacer del hogar el primer lugar de humanización y florecimiento. Without doubt, a good home is of great importance to the happiness of our families. Rapid and profound cultural changes over the past century have left us without a reliable template for creating such a good home, leaving us at the mercy of a consumer culture wh

products.title: Reclaimed: Win the War of Freedom, Self-Mastery, and Holy Purity
products.body_html: You were made for greatness—but the culture around you is trying to convince you otherwise. The permissive sexual wisdom of our time has failed. In a world hijacked by half-truths about freedom, love, and masculinity, young men are caught in a battle for their hearts. The good news: You don’t have to settle for addiction, shame, or mediocrity. You were made for more. This is your field manual for the fight ahead—a clear, practical, roadmap to authentic masculinity and self-mastery. Drawing on timeless wisdom and real-world pastoral experience, Fr. Carter Griffin offers tried-and-true tactics to understand the battlefield, break free from cycles of shame and addiction, lead a more flourishing life, and rediscover the joy of loving as God intended.

products.title: The God of Joy and the Problem of Pain
products.body_html: Why would a good God allow so much suffering? Why doesn't God take away our pain? Some say he allows it. Others call it punishment. Still others dare to name it a gift. But what is the truth—and how do we live under the weight of suffering that seems senseless, tragic, or cruel? In a world marked by natural disasters, devastating illness, war, abuse, and untimely death, many wonder why an all-powerful, loving God wouldn't simply make a better world. Couldn't he have prevented it all? With clarity, compassion, and the depth of Catholic tradition, the author invites readers into the heart of the Church's wisdom on human suffering, an age-old mystery that touches every life. This book explores: The nature of evil and why God permits it Whether suffering has meaning—and if so, what might that be How Jesus transforms pain from within What it means to believe in a God of joy in a world of sorrow Whether you are struggling personally or seeking to understand the suffering of others, this book offers a faithful, honest, and hope-filled perspective for those who dare to ask: Why?

products.title: The Tenth Hour: Ten Transforming Encounters with Jesus in the Gospels
products.body_html: Have you ever considered that each encounter with Jesus in the Gospels is an invitation for you personally? Joe Billmeier guides readers through ten powerful Gospel scenes where ordinary people meet Jesus—and are never the same again. From Bartimaeus the blind beggar who dared to cry out, to Zacchaeus who climbed a sycamore tree, to Simon of Cyrene unexpectedly pressed into carrying the Cross, each story reveals the lasting transformation that comes from meeting Christ face-to-face. Personal reflection follows each Gospel text, showing how these encounters, ancient yet timeless, can speak directly into the challenges of our own lives: loneliness, restlessness, hardship, and the desire for deeper purpose. Each chapter helps you see not just what happened then, but what can happen now, when you open yourself to the presence of Jesus. Whether you are seeking direction, strength, or a renewal of faith, this book is a personal invitation to recognize your own "tenth hour"—that decisive moment when Christ looks at you, calls you, and sets you on the path of mission made just for you.

products.title: Introducción a la Vida Devota (Introduction to Devout Life)
products.body_html: Desde el momento mismo en que empezó a difundirse la Introducción a la vida devota (año 1608), tuvo un éxito rotundo. Su intento conseguido de poner amable y exigentemente la devoción profunda, seria y tierna, al alcance de las gentes que viven en el mundo fue acogido con entusiasmo. San Francisco de Sales muestra que el deseo de santidad es realizable para las personas que viven entre los avatares del mundo, lugar en el que Dios los ha puesto. El frescor y la espontaneidad con que nos habla ha mantenido vivas durante cuatro siglos sus palabras, su fina penetración psicológica no es fruto del estudio, sino de la experiencia de un hombre de Dios a quien el hambre de almas atormenta y recome. From the very moment the Introduction to the Devout Life began to spread (in 1608), it was a resounding success. Its successful attempt to gently and demandingly make profound, serious, and tender devotion accessible to people living in the world was enthusiastically received. Saint Francis de Sales shows that the desire for holiness is achievable for people who live amid the vicissitudes of the world, the place where God has placed them. The freshness and spontaneity with which he speaks to us

products.title: ¿Dios Existe? (Does God Exist?)
products.body_html: ¿Existe Dios? Ayer como hoy, hombres y mujeres de todos los tiempos, especialmente ante las dificultades y las propias fragilidades, se han planteado esta pregunta. Grandes santos y pecadores, creyentes y ateos, intelectuales y gente sencilla. Pero más aún en una época como la nuestra, en la que muchos aseguran el fin del cristianismo y el destronamiento de Dios, una época en la que el hombre naufraga en la ilusión de un nuevo sentido de la vida, caracterizado por la fugacidad y la trivialidad, que lo abarca todo y realmente no posee nada. En estas páginas el cardenal Robert Sarah responde a muchas preguntas sobre la existencia y presencia de Dios en nuestras vidas, sobre su aparente silencio, sobre la muerte, sobre el sufrimiento, sobre el dolor, sobre la alegría. Hoy, quizá más que ayer, todos tenemos una fuerte necesidad de respuestas claras y fundadas, de testimonios tangibles, de encuentros que revelen la existencia y la presencia visible de Dios. Como en Zaqueo, hay en nosotros el deseo de verdad y plenitud, necesitamos «ver a Cristo» para llenar esa «carencia» que nos recuerda constantemente que Dios existe. «Este libro nació del intento de responder a las preguntas del edit

products.title: Cántico Espiritual de San Juan de la Cruz (Spiritual Canticle of St. John of The Cross)
products.body_html: Es la primera obra comenzada y acabada por san Juan de la Cruz. Atendiendo a sus partes integrantes, solía designarla así: Contiene una serie de «canciones espirituales» -plasmadas en unos versos impactantes por su belleza y calado-, seguidas por los magisteriales «comentarios» a cada una de ellas. A partir de la edición de 1630 se difundió universalmente su título actual, referido al conjunto del poema y declaración en prosa. En su redacción es la obra más armónica y unitaria del Santo. Y su tema no es otro sino la narración del «itinerario amoroso del alma» basado en el simbolismo tradicional del amor esponsal o nupcial y enmarcado en el esquema clásico de las etapas o estadios de la evolución espiritual. It is the first work begun and completed by Saint John of the Cross. Considering its constituent parts, he used to designate it as follows: It contains a series of "spiritual songs"—composed in striking verses for their beauty and depth—followed by the masterful "commentaries" on each of them. From the 1630 edition onward, its current title, referring to the entire poem and prose declaration, became universally known. In its composition, it is the saint's most harmonious and uni

products.title: Jacques Philippe's Spiritual Reading Starter Pack
products.body_html: Transform your spiritual life with three essential books from renowned retreat master Fr. Jacques Philippe. This specially curated collection addresses fundamental pillars of Catholic spiritual growth: interior freedom, lasting peace, and a strong prayer life. What's Included: Interior Freedom - Discover the unshakeable freedom that comes from faith, hope, and love—even in life's most challenging circumstances Searching for and Maintaining Peace - Learn practical Gospel responses to anxiety and distress while cultivating confidence in God's loving care Time for God - Master the principles of mental prayer with guidance from an experienced spiritual director Perfect for Catholics seeking to move beyond surface-level faith into deeper communion with God. Fr. Philippe's clear, accessible writing style makes profound spiritual truths practical for everyday life. Save 15% when you buy all three books together.

products.title: St. Thomas More Collection
products.body_html: In 1929, G.K. Chesterton prophesied that “Thomas More is more important at this moment than at any moment since his death . . . but he is not quite so important as he will be in a hundred years.” Thomas More was a leading Renaissance thinker and champion for self-government and free speech. His life shows us what it means to actively engage in the events of our time with courage and true prudence. His writings challenge us to examine ourselves in light of history and revelation, and ultimately, to be the best versions of ourselves in good times and in bad. The collection includes: For All Seasons: Selected Letters of Thomas More The Life of Pico The Four Last Things: The Supplication of Souls Dialogue Concerning Heresies A Dialogue of Comfort Against Tribulation The Sadness of Christ In these writings you will discover: Intimate access to the inspiring life and character of Thomas More: an ordinary lawyer who dared to be great. Tough questions that will make you think and examine your true motivations in the spiritual struggle. True supernatural perspectives that help us see this life and its trials in their proper place. Encouragement and good advice to face life’s difficulties wi

products.title: Carlo Acutis, el apostol de los milenials (The apostle of the millennials)
products.body_html: Carlo era un apasionado de Internet, como recordó el papa Francisco en la exhortación apostólica Christus vivit ; un apasionado de Internet que amaba a Jesús y quería darlo a conocer a todo el mundo. Con su vida, dio testimonio de que la modernidad y las nuevas tecnologías pueden ser una gran oportunidad para «llevar el Evangelio a toda la creación» (Mc 16, 15). De hecho, muchos se lo imaginan como patrono de la Red. La primera parte de esta obra presenta las «virtudes heroicas» de Carlo Acutis, que le abrieron el camino al Paraíso. La segunda muestra el corazón del apostolado de Carlo: el amor por Jesús Eucaristía, con un capítulo sobre los milagros eucarísticos. Al final del libro, una carta a los milenials reelaborada con palabras de Carlo a lo largo de su vida: un mensaje de gran valor para las nuevas generaciones.

products.title: The Busy Parent's Guide to the Catholic Faith: Short Answers to the Big Questions
products.body_html: Big Questions Deserve Good Answers. What do you say when your child asks, "How do we know God exists?" or "Why do Catholics believe in the Eucharist?" or "Isn't science enough?" For decades, Catholic educator and parent Steven R. Hemler has been writing summaries to help answer the big faith questions young people ask—and this book is the fruit of that work. A practical, easy-to-use resource, anyone entrusted with nurturing the faith of the next generation—including parents, grandparents, godparents, Confirmation sponsors, catechists, and teachers—will find this book invaluable. With short, standalone chapters written in plain, engaging language, Hemler offers solid, theologically sound answers to the real questions Catholics face today. Inside you'll find: Bite-sized, compelling explanations of core Catholic beliefs Faith-building responses to tough questions about science, suffering, morality, and more Encouragement and confidence for adults tasked with teaching the faith A helpful tool for campus ministers, youth leaders, and OCIA teams A great read for teens and young adults looking for honest, accessible answers Whether you're preparing your child for Confirmation, navigating

products.title: John Henry Newman Book Set - Discover the Newest Doctor of the Church!
products.body_html: Discover the Newest Doctor of the Church - Save 15% Celebrate St. John Henry Newman , soon to be declared a Doctor of the Church by Pope Leo XIV, with this essential 5-book collection. Newman on the Bible by William Park ($17.95) - Selected biblical commentaries and character studies showcasing Newman's exegetical mastery Holiness in a Secular Age by Fr. Juan Vélez ($21.95) - Exploration of Newman's relevance for modern Catholics The Rule of Our Warfare by St. John Henry Newman ($14.95) - Spiritual guidance excerpts covering faith, temptation, prayer, and Christian living from Newman's sermons Brave Leader, Big Heart by Fr. Juan Vélez ($14.95) - Biography perfect for younng readers, bringing Newman's adventures to life Mystical Rose by St. John Henry Newman ($14.95) - Newman's profound examination of Marian devotion through Scripture and Church Fathers

products.title: Libro de la vida de Santa Teresa de Jesús. Adaptación al español actual (The Book of the Life of St. Theresa of Jesus. Adapted to Modern Spanish Language)
products.body_html: He aquí una nueva edición del “Libro de la Vida”, adaptada en este caso al castellano de hoy. El “Libro de la Vida” de Sta. Teresa de Jesús es uno de los clásicos más consagrados de toda nuestra espiritualidad. En él proyecta su autora, no tanto el perfil histórico de su existencia, cuanto el caudal de su experiencia de Dios. Edición pensada y orientada hacia los talleres y grupos de oración. Here is a new edition of the "Book of the Life," adapted in this case into modern Spanish. The "Book of the Life" by St. Teresa of Jesus is one of the most time-honored classics of our entire spirituality. In it, its author projects not so much the historical outline of her life, but rather the wealth of her experience of God. This edition is designed and oriented toward workshops and prayer groups.

products.title: Cinco y Cinco - Set Completo: Enero-Diciembre ( Cinco Minutos de Oración Por la Mañana y Cinco Por la Tarde (Five and Five: Five Minutes of Prayer in the Morning and Five Minutes in the Evening: January-December)
products.body_html: Estos libros forman una colección que abarca los doce meses del año y los tiempos liturgicos. Para cada día se ofrecen dos meditaciones breves, como guías para la conversación con Dios. Ambas se refieren a una misma temática, lo que permite, para el que lo desee, hacer una sola meditación diaria, uniendo ambas. Tambien se pueden comprar individualmente, mes por mes. These books form a collection that covers the twelve months of the year and the liturgical seasons. Two short meditations are offered for each day, as guides for conversation with God. Both refer to the same theme, allowing those who wish to do so to do a single daily meditation, combining both. They can also be purchased individually, month by month.

products.title: A Boy-Sized Cross
products.body_html: In a time when being Catholic in Japan could cost you everything , ten-year-old Louis Ibaraki has more questions than answers. Orphaned, proud, and struggling to trust, Louis is thrown into a world of strange Latin prayers, secret Masses, and quiet heroism. Then he meets Maxium Tayeka—a swordsmith's son with a steady heart and a quiet strength—and everything begins to change. As the two grow in faith and friendship, so does the danger around them. When Japan's rulers turn against the Church, Louis and Maximus must decide what they believe—and how far they are willing to go to stand for it. Based on the true story of St. Louis Ibaraki, the youngest of the Twenty-Six Martyrs of Nagasaki, A Boy-Sized Cross is a gripping historical novel of courage, sacrifice, and the surprising power of childlike faith. This is not just a story about dying for Christ. It's a story about living for him—even when the world tells you not to.

products.title: Coached by Catherine of Siena: Lessons in Charity
products.body_html: What if one of the Church's most fiery mystics could mentor you in prayer, charity, and holiness, right where you are? Walk alongside St. Catherine of Siena as she teaches you how to grow in love of God, neighbor, and the Church. Drawing deeply from her letters and prayers, this book brings Catherine's bold wisdom into your daily life—not as a distant mystic to admire, but as a spiritual coach who meets you in your struggles and calls you to rise above them. Catherine doesn't ask you to levitate or to live on nothing but the Eucharist. She asks you to begin. Again and again. Through daily prayer, honest self-knowledge, and sacrificial love, she shows how every Christian, no matter how weak or ordinary, can become a saint. Whether you're battling distraction, discouragement, pride, or sloth, Catherine has been there—and she will not let you stay stuck. She speaks with authority, tenderness, and with a burning desire for your holiness. Let her coach you. And let God, through her and out of complete love for you, make you new.

products.title: Heaven Can't Wait: A Glimpse of the Eternal in the Present
products.body_html: "What if heaven isn't just our destination, and happiness isn't something we wait for, but realities we can begin to live now ?" In this warm, accessible guide to Christian joy, Fr. Edward Maristany invites readers into a refreshing and deeply hopeful vision of the Chistian life—one where joy is not postponed until the next world, but encountered right here in the present. With wisdom rooted in Scripture, the saints, and the lived experience of the Church, Fr. Maristany guides us through the spiritual logic of happiness: God's plan for us, the tragedy of sin, the healing power of Christ, and the grace-filled path to sanctity in ordinary life. Along the way, he answers the questions every believer faces: How can I be happy despite suffering? How do I live faithfully in a broken world? What does God want from me—today, now? This book is a heartfelt call to live as beloved sons and daughters of God, to find meaning in the moment, and to walk the daily road of faith with confidence, peace, and purpose. If you've ever longed or more than momentary pleasure—if you want lasting joy and a life that bears eternal fruit—this book is for you. Because for the Christian, heaven can't wait .

products.title: Cinco y Cinco: Cinco Minutos de Oración Por la Mañana y Cinco Por la Tarde, Diciembre (Five and Five: Five Minutes of Prayer in the Morning and Five in the Evening, December)
products.body_html: Estos libros forman una colección que abarca los doce meses del año y los tiempos liturgicos. Para cada día se ofrecen dos meditaciones breves, como guías para la conversación con Dios. Ambas se refieren a una misma temática, lo que permite, para el que lo desee, hacer una sola meditación diaria, uniendo ambas. These books form a collection that covers the twelve months of the year and the liturgical seasons. Two short meditations are offered for each day, as guides for conversation with God. Both address the same theme, allowing those who wish to do so to combine the two into a single daily meditation.

products.title: Quiero oir tú voz (I want to hear your voice)
products.body_html: Jesús nos habla y mucho.Lo hace en nuestro interior, cada día y en cada circunstancia. Santa Teresita asegura que, a nosotros, ahora, nos habla más que a los discípulos que convivieron con Él. Las frases aquí recogidas no son sino sencillas propuestas para escucharlo. Jesus speaks to us a lot. He does so within us, every day and in every circumstance. Saint Therese assures us that He speaks to us more now than to the disciples who lived with Him. The phrases gathered here are nothing more than simple proposals to listen to Him.

products.title: Señor mío y Dios mío: La Eucaristía en la Teología Vivida de los Santos (My Lord and My God: The Eucharist in the Lived Theology of the Saints)
products.body_html: En esta obra se hilan textos de santos y escritores de espiritualidad sobre algún aspecto del misterio eucarístico. Su objetivo es ofrecer matices del Santísimo Sacramento que ayuden a encender chispas de oración. San Juan Pablo II invitaba a seguir “la enseñanza de los Santos, grandes intérpretes de la verdadera piedad eucarística. Con ellos la teología de la Eucaristía adquiere todo el esplendor de la experiencia vivida, nos ‘contagia’ y, por así decir, nos ‘enciende’” (Enc. Ecclesia de Eucharistia, n. 62), con la ininterrumpida presencia materna de María pues Ella es, como lo fue para los Apóstoles, memoria de Cristo. This work weaves together texts from saints and writers of spirituality about some aspect of the Eucharistic mystery. Its aim is to offer nuances of the Most Holy Sacrament that help ignite sparks of prayer. Saint John Paul II invited us to follow 'the teachings of the Saints, great interpreters of true Eucharistic piety. With them, the theology of the Eucharist gains all the splendor of lived experience, it 'contagiously' inspires us and, so to speak, 'ignites' us' (Enc. Ecclesia de Eucharistia, n. 62), with the uninterrupted maternal presence of Mary, as she was

products.title: Para confesarse bien. El Sacramento de la Alegria (Making a Good Confession. The Sacrament of Joy)
products.body_html: ¿Quieres volver a ocupar tu puesto en la inmensa marcha de la humanidad hacia el Reino de Dios…? El sacramento de la penitencia te brinda la oportunidad para ese encuentro personal y hondo con Cristo, que te reconduce al Padre y a tus hermanos. Es el sacramento de la alegría. En el presente escrito encontrarás las razones para comprenderlo como un inmenso regalo, y sabrás también cómo practicarlo con fruto. Incluye un amplio examen de conciencia, especialmente útil para quienes no han recibido en mucho tiempo el sacramento de la misericordia divina. «Confesarse bien» es la ocasión de reorientar el camino hacia el proyecto vital que tanto anhelamos. Do you want to return to your place in humanity's immense journey toward the Kingdom of God? The sacrament of penance offers you the opportunity for that personal and profound encounter with Christ, which leads you back to the Father and to your brothers and sisters. It is the sacrament of joy. In this book, you will find the reasons to understand it as an immense gift, and you will also learn how to practice it fruitfully. It includes a comprehensive examination of conscience, especially useful for those who have not received the sacram

products.title: The Company We Keep: True Friendship and Why it Matters
products.body_html: "No one has greater love than this: to lay down one's life for one's friends." –John 15:13 What does it mean to live friendship as a Christian? In a culture of fleeting connections and digital noise, The Company We Keep offers a compelling return to the wisdom of Aristotle, St. Thomas Aquinas, the Gospel, and Christian tradition to rediscover the lost art and meaning of true friendship as a vital part of holiness and disicpleship. Catholic philosopher Michael Pakaluk invites readers to see friendship not as optional, but essential: a moral, spiritual, and deeply human bond that reflects our highest calling. With clarity and warmth, he explores the kinds of friendship that shape our lives—from casual camaraderie to the deep, sacrificial love between spouses, parents, and children. Whether you seek richer relationships, deeper community, or a more meaningful life of faith, this book will challenge and inspire you to choose your company wisely—and to become the kind of friend that is crucial and indispensable in the lives of your loved ones. It is a book about community, growing in love, and following Christ more closely—together.

products.title: Del resentimiento al perdon (From resentment to forgiveness)
products.body_html: Todos queremos ser felices. En el intrincado recorrido que esto conlleva, solemos encontrarnos con un tono emocional que tiñe las relaciones humanas: el resentimiento. Se extiende en conversaciones críticas, en quejas, lamentaciones y pensamientos negativos. Pero también afecta a las amistades, familias y matrimonios. El germen del resentimiento es capaz de ir sembrando un afán de reivindicación o de venganza, provocando problemas sociales, laborales y personales. Este libro aborda la entramada problemática del resentimiento y la simpleza que otorga el perdón para salir de él. El perdón —cuyo estudio resulta más fácil que su práctica— se nos presenta como un recurso liberador mientras buscamos la felicidad. We all want to be happy. Perhaps the greatest obstacle to happiness for most people is resentment. It’s easy to see how widespread this problem is: just notice the critical tone of so many conversations, the anger, the complaints and lamentations, the excuses, negative thoughts, frustrations, the distancing of person from person, family divisions, marriage breakdowns, eagerness for vindication or vengeance, labor disputes, social problems, even conflicts between nations. products.title: Coached by the Saints Set
products.body_html: Unlock Timeless Wisdom: The "Coached by the Saints" Collection! Transform your spiritual life with some of history's most inspiring guides. The "Coached by the Saints" series offers profound insights and practical lessons from the lives of the saints, helping you navigate the challenges of modern life with faith, courage, and joy. Coached by Catherine of Siena: Lessons in Charity by Joan Watson Coached by the Curé: Lessons in Shepherding with St. John Vianney by Kevin Wells Coached by Josemaría Escrivá: Lessons in Discipleship by Fr.
